about: Raw resources in Sandbox worlds (docs/sandbox/CONSTRUCTS.md, 'Gathering'): plentiful, but grouped by type. Each kind scatters large deposits over the world, one chance per 'cell' metres square. 'surface' deposits grow trees a Saw Module cuts; 'underground' ones are tapped by a Drill Module. 'units' is what one deposit holds (underground) or one tree gives (surface). An underground kind's 'outcrop' shows it on the surface: a long streak of rock clusters, 'spacing' metres apart, of 'size' metres high (low, high) and colour 'tint'. Maps add or replace deposits in their sandbox section's 'resources'.
